# Requirements Document

## Introduction

Albums group photos by date.

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Album Management

**Objective:** As a user, I want to create and delete albums, so that my photos stay organised.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a user creates an album THEN the Photo Album Application SHALL give it the creation date
2. IF an album contains no photos THEN the Photo Album Application SHALL allow the user to delete it

### Requirement 2: Photos

**Objective:** As a user, I want to add photos to an album, so that they are grouped.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a user adds a photo to an album THEN the Photo Album Application SHALL list it in that album
